name: Emerald Grid
description: Tahliliy grid uslubi: professional yashil aksentlar, chap navigatsiya paneli, ikki ustunli strukturali reja va data-driven ko'rinishlar. Tahlil, hisobot va ma'lumot taqdimotlari uchun.
prompt_guidance: Use precise analytical wording with categories, contrasts, and measurable differences where available.
Prefer compact row-like facts for table sections because this template highlights structured comparison.
Make agenda items specific: use real categories, time periods, metrics, or sections from the topic.
Use 1-2 table sections when the topic contains comparisons, classifications, or data.
Keep facts factual, short, and decision-ready.
